name: Conservator's UV Lamp
summary: Dashboards hang like paintings that look flawless in normal light; a UV lamp reveals the overpainted figure and a human conservator decides.
look: A warm museum wall with gilt frames and label cards, then a dim studio where a violet UV pool makes hidden data fluoresce teal and the anomaly glow coral. A brass loupe and a paper condition report keep it restrained and credible.

components.name: Framed dashboard
components.role: gilt frame, mat and chart as the artwork, with a museum label

components.name: UV pool
components.role: radial violet mask carried by a wand; the agent itself

components.name: Fluorescent layer
components.role: the real data under the painted surface; coral where it disagrees

components.name: Brass loupe
components.role: 2.5× circle clip isolating the anomaly figure

components.name: Condition report
components.role: mono checklist; the failing line carries anomaly and deploy

components.name: Conservator's decision
components.role: Roll back / Acknowledge; the human signs

motion.name: Lamp pass
motion.how: mask follows a bezier over 2.5 s (five beats at 120 BPM), power1.inOut, arriving on the anomaly on a downbeat

motion.name: Fluoresce
motion.how: revealed layer 0→1 behind a glow filter in 0.3 s; 0.8 s afterglow once the lamp moves on

motion.name: Loupe punch-in
motion.how: circle scales 0→1 with back.out(1.7) in 0.35 s on the snare; report line types in with steps() over the next bar

story: Hook: '38 dashboards. All looked fine.' A gallery of framed charts, 'last inspected: never'. Reveal: lights off, the UV wand clicks on and 'Acme Pulse' fluoresces on the drop. Proof: the pool drifts over the Checkout chart; the smooth painted line fluoresces into the real one dropping after 09:42, the loupe reads '−18% since 09:42', the condition report logs 'overpainted by deploy #2231', and the conservator taps Roll back. CTA: warm lights return on one framed Acme lockup, 'Caught before customers noticed.', museum label, Start free.
adapt: Hang your own report, invoice or config as the artwork and let the UV layer show what your product checks underneath; the condition report becomes your finding list.

fit.risk: Glow can tip into sci-fi; keep the paper warm and the museum restrained.
